name: Alex D. Silagi

biography.text: Silagi earned a B.A. from Rutgers University (2010) and a J.D. from Seton Hall University School of Law (2014). He practiced at Carter Ledyard and Proskauer Rose, clerked for District Judge Madeline Cox Arleo and Third Circuit Judge Morton I. Greenberg, and served as an Assistant U.S. Attorney in New Jersey from 2020 to 2026, including as deputy chief of the Civil Division.
